manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Saheeli's Artistry
description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Saheeli's Artistry, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Saheeli's Artistry, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
